issues.title: Army boss in cuffs:Ex-Malawi Defence Force commander arrested over ‘illegal arms trafficking’ and terrorism-linked offences

issues.title: Jordan’s Food Security Supported by Key Agricultural Sectors
issues.title_en: Jordan’s Food Security Supported by Key Agricultural Sectors
issues.summary: Jordan’s tomato crop stands out as the country’s leading vegetable export, with annual production of 400,000–500,000 tonnes, while the food sector ranks 10th globally with a value of $136 billion, according to a global food commodities ranking published by Visual Capitalist.
